text:
Marie CSM: quick heads-up — three midsize accounts (MapleTech, LumaLabs, Parkside) dropped MAU ~40% week-over-week. thinking we should run a 'staircase' retention play instead of immediate downgrade. want quick feedback + owners. :thinking:

Anil R: curious, what's the staircase idea in 1 line?

Marie CSM: gradual entitlement taper + conversion nudges. not a hard downgrade. steps look like:
- week 0: flag & CSM outreach (30m checkin)
- week 1: limit non-critical exported tokens to 70% + targeted tips email
- week 2: reduced burst capacity window (peak concurrency drops) + tailored promo for relevant feature
- week 3: if no re-engage, present formal downgrade options and renewal discussion

Priya S: sounds safer than blind downgrade. can we add an enablement touchpoint to cover missed onboarding steps? maybe a 20m product walkthrough at step 1.

Marie CSM: yes — add enablement 20m at step 1. I'll own MapleTech. Priya, can you take LumaLabs? @Jamie SE can you prep a 10-min 'what you lost' diff for Parkside so they see value gap?

Jamie SE: on it. will create a one-pager + short demo clip. ETA tomorrow EOD.

Anil R: quick ask for CS Ops — can KevBot schedule the outreach cadence and apply the entitlement flags automatically? we need to avoid manual slips.

KevBot: auto-schedule created:
```
trigger: usage_drop_40pct
workflow: staircase_retention_v1
notifications: CSM + Enablement
actions:
  - set_export_quota: 70%
  - set_burst_window: reduced
  - schedule_meetings: 7d/14d
```
Deployed to staging. will push to prod after one quick dry-run. :white_check_mark:

Priya S: also let's capture feedback in the same thread: one question to ask during outreach — "what blocked you from using X last month?" and add to shared doc.

Marie CSM: agreed. I'll add responses to the account row in the retention tracker. action items:
- Marie: outreach + add feedback to tracker (MapleTech)
- Priya: outreach + walkthrough (LumaLabs)
- Jamie: one-pager + demo for Parkside (tomorrow EOD)
- Anil: sign-off on final messaging by 10am PT
- KevBot: run dry-run for automation and report back

Marie CSM: if all good, we'll run this play on the next 12 flagged accounts with same pattern. low friction, preserves revenue, gives us quality signals. :rocket:
